query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_active,
  SUM(CASE WHEN address_city IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_address,
  SUM(CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as geocoded,
  SUM(CASE WHEN address_city IS NOT NULL AND latitude IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_geocode
FROM pco_people 
WHERE status = 'active';
